findings.summary: All seven C1 deliverables verified against the approved spec. Versioned schema (deploy/contract/application-declaration.v1.schema.json) covers identity, artifact ref+immutable commit, command, working_directory, required_environment, health.command, rollback ref+commit. Two declarations exist (deep-research runnable, chatgroup-daemon declaration-only with placeholder 40-zero commit). runPreflight (src/preflight.ts:202) is deterministic and read-only: validates schema, known application, immutable commit format (40-hex lowercase), artifact/working-directory existence, required-environment presence, executable command availability, health-command syntax, each with a stable error_code and nonzero exit, before any deploy action; no deploy branch exists -- runner uses only fs.readFileSync/existsSync/accessSync(X_OK) (grep confirmed zero mutation primitives in preflight.ts/preflight-entry.ts). --preflight-only emits resolved immutable commit (c76594d5f9e45a557b56044d585419a30a3113a8) and stable sha256 declaration digest. Raw green/red stdout+stderr fixtures (test/fixtures/preflight/) are acceptance evidence: GREEN = status=PASS/application=deep-research/commit/digest; RED = nonzero/status=FAIL/error_code=REQUIRED_ENV_MISSING/no phase:deploy or effects marker. c1-preflight.test.ts drives the real CLI entrypoint via execFileSync(vite-node src/preflight-entry.ts) -- does not mock the runner. deploy/README.md sec 5 states the deployment alignment proof (declaration commit == checked artifact commit; deploy only from merged remote main + git pull --ff-only in production checkout; production checkout never a dev/verification location). Prior blockers resolved: the implement verification record (.dev-dispatch/handoffs/dc2fd784.../implement.json) now runs the unscoped `npm test` acceptance command with exit_code 0 and {failed:0, passed:793, total:793}, alongside npm ci/typecheck/smoke:cas all exit 0; work_head_commit (821f63744c2743e96719f63632c8c86ae17a6ce5) matches the dispatch product commit. test/a10b-convergence.test.ts adds a deterministic compatibility probe (loopEngineRegistryCompatible) that it.skip's B1/B2 with a named message when the external loop-engine build cannot load the current model registry -- honest explicit skip (same discipline as missing bun/CLI), not a silent pass, and does not touch the C1 preflight runner or its tests. docs/deploy.md semantics unchanged (still D1/D2 profile-based); C1 adds a separate deploy/README.md. No chatgroup-daemon app-specific deploy behavior. All review-bar criteria satisfied.
